controlBarHint: Floating bar with timer, pause and stop over the tab being recorded.
micWarning: Warn me if the microphone is off
settingsLocked: Can be changed when you are not recording.
settingsError: Could not save the settings. Try again.
settingsLoadError: Could not read the settings. Try again.
tabUnavailable: Open a web page in the active tab to be able to record it.
microphoneListError: Could not list the microphones. Check the permissions and try again.
choosing: Choose the tab you want to record…
permissionNeeded: Allow the microphone in the tab that opened and start the recording again.
permissionOpenError: Could not open the microphone permission page. Try again.
tabError: Could not record this tab. Open Sauri from its icon in a web tab and try again.
audioError: Choose the tab again and leave the option to share tab audio checked.
surfaceError: Choose a Chrome tab, not a window or a screen.
sharingEndedError: Tab sharing stopped before the recording began. If that was not you, reload the meeting tab and try again.
startError: Could not start the recording. Try again.
commandError: Could not complete the action. Try again.
noOverlay: This tab does not support the control bar: use this panel to pause or stop.
recordingHelp: You can close this panel: the recording keeps going. When you stop, it is saved and uploaded by itself; you will see its progress in the portal.
micOffDescription: Without a microphone, the recording will have only the tab audio and your voice will not be heard.
enableMic: Turn on the microphone and continue
unavailable: The service is not available right now.
empty: You have no recordings yet. Record your first tab to get started.
uploadHelp: When it reaches 100%, the meeting will open in the portal.
uploadFailureHelp: The upload did not complete. You can retry or save a copy that is available on this computer.
download: Save a copy on this computer
downloadError: Could not save the copy. No local data is available or it could not be read.
retryError: Could not retry the upload. Try again later.
processing: It is already being transcribed in the portal.
persistenceError: Could not read the saved state. It has not been confirmed that it was saved.
captureErrorHelp: The recording has a capture error. It has not been confirmed that it was saved.
uploadUnknown: The upload has not been confirmed
reviewPending: Opening the meeting in the portal…
noSpeechHelp: This recording has no speech to transcribe. Check that the microphone or the tab audio was on.
processingFailedHelp: You can open it in the portal to see the details.
openLocalApp: Open Sauri on your Mac to record or view your meetings
